observed:
OBSERVED divergence — Frame axes where the four differ:
  epistemic-warrant: MATT=revelation, MARK=testimony, LUKE=testimony, JOHN=testimony
  inferential-operation: MATT=exegesis, MARK=causal-explanation, LUKE=exegesis, JOHN=exegesis
  telos: MATT=fidelity-service, MARK=salvation, LUKE=salvation, JOHN=salvation
  hermeneutic-posture: MATT=literal, MARK=literal, LUKE=reparative-integrative, JOHN=performative
  r_topology: MATT=delegated-voice, MARK=delegated-voice, LUKE=delegated-voice, JOHN=filial-asymmetry
  r_condition: MATT=covenantal, MARK=covenantal, LUKE=covenantal, JOHN=beloved-seeking
Plus the documented reception-variant: the earliest formula (1 Cor 15) names only MEN, omitting the women first-witnesses the gospels foreground.

Frame:r_topology.predicted_spread: If r_topology were the differentiator, Matthew/Mark/Luke would cluster on delegated-voice (commissioned witnesses, sent-out speech, apostolic relay) while John alone would render a filial-asymmetry topology (Father-Son intimacy, Mary/Beloved-Disciple recognition scenes, 'I ascend to my Father'). The synoptics would share commissioning grammar; John would diverge into recognition-and-belonging grammar.
Frame:r_topology.why: Reproduces the 3-vs-1 Johannine split on r_topology/r_condition/posture, but cannot regenerate Matthew's distinctive revelation/fidelity-service profile nor the 1 Cor 15 male-only reception variant.

Frame:epistemic-warrant.predicted_spread: If epistemic-warrant were the differentiator, Matthew alone would ground the resurrection in revelation (angelic descent, earthquake, direct disclosure from heaven) while Mark/Luke/John would ground it in testimony (witness reports, empty-tomb inspection, appearance narratives with named seers). Matthew's account would foreground apocalyptic disclosure grammar; the other three would foreground chains of human witness.
Frame:epistemic-warrant.why: Cleanly reproduces the Matthew-vs-rest 1-vs-3 split on warrant (and correlates with its fidelity-service/exegesis profile), but leaves John's topology/posture divergence and the 1 Cor 15 male-witness variant unexplained.

Sitz:political_institutional.predicted_spread: If political-institutional Sitz were the differentiator, Matthew would reflect a synagogue-adjacent Jewish-Christian community under polemic pressure (guards-at-the-tomb apologetic, fidelity-to-Torah framing), Mark a persecuted Roman-context community (terse, fear-ending), Luke a Greco-Roman civic-apologetic setting (orderly testimony, Theophilus, respectable witnesses), and John a synagogue-expelled sectarian community (insider filial intimacy, beloved-disciple in-group recognition). Each account's warrant, telos, and topology would track its institutional pressure.
Sitz:political_institutional.why: Plausibly regenerates Matthew's fidelity/revelation profile, John's filial-asymmetry in-group posture, AND the 1 Cor 15 male-witness variant (Pauline civic-legal witness norms), though the Mark/Luke split on posture is only loosely entailed.

Lineage:source-leaning.predicted_spread: If source-leaning lineage were the differentiator, Mark (earliest, Petrine-oral) would give the terse causal-explanation core, Matthew (Mark+M+Hebrew-scripture heavy) would layer exegetical revelation and Torah-fidelity, Luke (Mark+Q+L, Pauline-adjacent) would produce reparative-integrative harmonizing of witness traditions, and John (independent Johannine stream) would render the filial/beloved-seeking material foreign to the Synoptic trunk. The 1 Cor 15 male-only formula reflects the pre-gospel Pauline lineage upstream of all four.
Lineage:source-leaning.why: Reproduces all six frame divergences AND the 1 Cor 15 reception variant as direct entailments of documented source streams, though it explains WHICH sources were used more than WHY each community drew on them.

Sitz:epidemic_health.predicted_spread: If epidemic-health Sitz were the differentiator, accounts written under acute plague pressure would foreground bodily healing, mortality-anxiety, and salvation-as-rescue, while those in healthier conditions would foreground fidelity/instruction. Luke (physician-tradition) might emphasize bodily verification, Mark urgency under mortal fear, John a mystical response to death, Matthew a stable teaching community — but no first-century plague episode cleanly aligns with the four datings.
Sitz:epidemic_health.why: No documented epidemic gradient across the four communities maps onto the specific warrant/posture/topology splits or the 1 Cor 15 male-witness variant.
